list.title: Bookings
list.subtitle: Manage bookings and tickets
list.info: A booking groups one or more tickets (one per passenger and seat). Payment will be linked to the treasury module later.

passenger.title: Passengers
passenger.subtitle: Reusable passenger file and loyalty
passenger.info: Passengers are recorded once and reused for every booking. Their ID document and phone number help avoid duplicates and feed loyalty.

returns.title: Returns to process
returns.subtitle: Assign the return trip of open round trips
returns.info: These round-trip bookings are already paid; the return has not been dated yet. On the return day, choose the booking, select the return trip and seats, then assign — the return tickets are issued (no payment).
returns.no_return_trip: No return trip for these criteria.

detail.title: Booking details
detail.subtitle: Tickets and lifecycle
detail.t_footer: Keep this ticket - present it at boarding.

new.subtitle: A single form — through to payment
new.info: Choose the class and time slot: matching trips appear. Select the trip and seats, each passenger's drop-off point (the fare adjusts), then take payment. The booking is created already paid.
new.return_open_check: Open return (return date/bus to be set later)
new.no_return_trip: No return trip for these criteria.
new.missing_fare_warn: A fare is missing for a selected segment. Set it in "Fares" before continuing.

register.title: Cash registers
register.subtitle: The institution's physical registers
register.info: Link each register to a treasury account (571x) and a cash journal so accounting entries post to the right sub-account.

session.title: Cash sessions
session.subtitle: Opening and closing registers
session.info: A session must be open on a register to record movements. On closing, the difference (counted − expected) is computed and posted.

movement.title: Movements
movement.subtitle: Treasury income and expenses
movement.info: Each movement automatically generates the matching accounting entry (badge "Posted"). Cash movements require an open session.
movement.no_session: No open session — open a session first.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.subtitle: The institution's bank accounts
bank.info: Link each bank account to a treasury account (52x) and a bank journal for automatic accounting posting.

transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.subtitle: Internal movements between registers and banks
transfer.info: Transfer funds between your registers and bank accounts. The accounting entry (Debit destination / Credit source) is generated automatically.

exp_voyage.title: Trip expenses
exp_voyage.subtitle: Trip-related expenses (generated by the schedule) — disbursement

exp_gen.title: General expenses
exp_gen.subtitle: Agency expenses not linked to a trip

pm.title: Payment methods
pm.subtitle: Configure payment methods and whether they require payment
pm.ph_code: generated from the name if empty

refund.title: Refund
refund.subtitle: Rate applied to the amount paid on cancellation
refund.label: Refund rate (%)
refund.hint: 0% = no refund. The refund comes from the agent's open register.

towns.title: Cities
towns.info: The cities served by the network. Each service point (station, agency or stop) belongs to a city.

slots.title: Time slots
slots.info: Departure slots (e.g. 00:00–05:00). Used to plan and resolve trips.

sp.title: Service points
sp.subtitle: Stations, agencies and stops
sp.info: Network stop points. Tick "Station/Agency" for a point where tickets are sold (route origin/destination). Others are simple stops that can serve as intermediate stops.

routes.title: Routes
routes.subtitle: Itineraries and stops
routes.info: A route links an origin station to a destination station. Add stops (service points, stations or simple stops) — they will be used for per-segment pricing.
routes.save_first: Save the route first to add stops.

cmt.title: Crew types
cmt.subtitle: Driver, Attendant, Inspector…
cmt.info: Crew member types. Tick "driver" for types allowed to drive (rule: a trip requires at least one driver).

et.title: Expense types
et.subtitle: Fuel, Toll, Allowance…
et.info: Trip expense types. Each type carries an OHADA expense account (class 6) used at disbursement.

cn.title: Parcel natures
cn.info: Parcel/luggage natures: fragile, to declare, prohibited. They qualify parcel types.

ct.title: Parcel types
ct.info: Pricing types for parcels/luggage (e.g. "parcel ≤ 50 kg"). "Applies to" restricts the type to luggage, parcels, or both.

fc.title: Fare classes
fc.info: Commercial classes (VIP, Classic…). Distinct from the physical seat type: a VIP class can be sold on a standard seat during a reroute.

cm.title: Crew members
cm.subtitle: Drivers, attendants, inspectors
cm.info: Roster of crew members assignable to trips. The type determines the role (including "driver").

va.title: Plan assignments
va.subtitle: Bus layout per vehicle (configuration history)
va.info: Links a bus layout to a vehicle over a period. Keeps the history of seat reconfigurations.

spat.title: Schedules
spat.subtitle: Service templates (route · slot · days)
spat.info: Templates that pre-fill the New trip form and are used to resolve the trip (route + date + slot + vehicle). No automatic generation.

es.title: Expense schedule
es.subtitle: Standard costs per route and fare class
es.info: Define standard costs (fuel, allowance, toll…) per route and fare class. Each trip created on this route will automatically inherit these expenses.

lr.title: Loyalty
lr.subtitle: Loyalty program rules
lr.info: Configure the number of points per trip and the threshold (number of points) from which the passenger gets a free ticket.

set.title: Trips settings
set.subtitle: Lead times, shifts and notifications
set.info: General settings of the Trips module for your institution: departure/arrival lead times, ticket expiry, shift duration, document alerts and default notifications.

plan.title: Bus layouts
plan.subtitle: Reusable seat layouts
plan.info: Draw the bus seat layout. Click an empty cell to add a seat, click a seat to change its type (Standard, VIP, Driver, Crew) or make it non-sellable.
plan.click_hint: Click a cell to add or edit a seat.

tt.title: Ticket config
tt.subtitle: Customize the ticket (form) — no HTML knowledge required
tt.info: Fill in the ticket's fixed info (company, colors, logos, terms, agencies). Only trip/passenger data is dynamic. A QR code containing the ticket info is added (scannable). "Preview" shows the rendering with sample data.
tt.no_agency: No agency. Add some to show them at the bottom of the back (name, district, phone).
tt.adv_hint: (for experts — replaces the template with your HTML; tokens

list.title: Trips
list.subtitle: Departures management
list.info: Create and track trips. After creation, assign an eligible vehicle (the bus layout and seats are generated automatically), the crew, then drive the lifecycle.
list.pat_hint: Route, class and schedule are defined by the schedule template.

detail.no_eligible: No eligible vehicle for this slot.
detail.crew_locked_suffix: : the crew can no longer be modified.
detail.no_seats: No seats — assign a vehicle to generate the layout.
detail.seat_hint: Click an available seat to block it (or vice versa). Sold/held seats will come with bookings.

ft.title: Fuel types
ft.info: Energy sources for your models: Petrol, Diesel, Electric, Hybrid, LPG. "Global" entries are provided by default.

pe.title: Periods
pe.info: Billing or recurrence frequencies: Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly.

uc.title: Unit categories
uc.info: Groups measurement units: Power, Distance, Emission, Volume.

vc.title: Vehicle categories
vc.info: Grouping of your vehicles: Van, Sedan, SUV, Bus, Minibus.

as.title: Activity sectors
as.info: Activity sectors of your fleet: Urban transport, Logistics, Mining, Agriculture.

it.title: Intervention types
it.info: Intervention types for maintenance and contracts: Oil change, Service, Repair, Insurance, Leasing. The category indicates whether they apply to services, contracts, or both.
it.interval_hint: Used to automatically schedule the next preventive maintenance.

un.title: Units
un.info: Measurement units linked to a category: hp, kW (Power); km, mi (Distance); g/km (Emission).

dt.title: Document types
dt.info: Types of administrative documents attached to vehicles: Insurance, Registration, Technical inspection, Road tax. "Expiration required" enables due-date tracking.

tg.title: Tags
tg.info: Tags to group and filter your vehicles: Pool, Management, Site, Rental. Assign them a color.

sup.title: Suppliers
sup.subtitle: Associated companies: parts, fuel, contracts, vehicles

br.title: Vehicle brands
br.subtitle: Manage brands in the global reference data

dr.title: Drivers
dr.subtitle: Driver register (identity from the HR module)
dr.info: A driver is an HR employee to whom license info is attached. Identity (name, contact…) comes from the HR module.
dr.no_employees: No HR employee available. Create employees in the HR module first.

dash.title: Dashboard — Fleet
dash.subtitle: Fleet overview and active alerts
dash.no_alerts_1: No active alerts for the next

svc.title: Services / Interventions
svc.subtitle: Maintenance, repairs and their attachments
svc.info: Record all interventions (services, repairs) and their attachments (invoices, photos). The intervention type determines preventive-maintenance recurrence.

ct.title: Contracts
ct.subtitle: Insurance, leasing and maintenance plans
ct.info: A contract groups insurance, leasing or maintenance plans, with their recurring costs (premiums, installments). Type and periodicity are configurable.

ag.title: Agencies
ag.subtitle: Your institution's agencies
ag.info: Manage your institution's agencies. Cash registers and ticket sales points can be attached to them.

role.title: Roles
role.subtitle: Manage roles and their permissions
role.delete_q: Are you sure you want to delete

perm.title: Permissions
perm.subtitle: Define the allowed permissions for this role
perm.search_ph: Search a permission by name, resource or code…

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Action history — 500 entries max
audit.empty: No log entries for these criteria.

profile.title: Profiles
profile.subtitle: Manage profiles and their roles
profile.subtitle_users: Manage user profiles and their roles

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage user accounts
users.temp_pwd_share: Share this temporary password with the user:
users.temp_pwd_hint: The user must change it on first login.
users.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.subtitle: OHADA accounts of the institution
accounts.info: SYSCOHADA chart of accounts pre-filled when the institution is created. You can add sub-accounts, edit labels and deprecate unused accounts.

journals.title: Journals
journals.subtitle: Accounting journals of the institution
journals.info: Standard journals (VTE, ACH, OD, PAIE, CAISSE, BANQUE) created when the institution is opened. Per-agency cash/bank journals will be managed by Treasury.

fy.title: Fiscal years & periods
fy.subtitle: Accounting fiscal years and monthly periods
fy.info: The current fiscal year and its 12 monthly periods are created when the institution is opened. Select a fiscal year to manage its periods.

reception.title: Parcel reception
reception.subtitle: Check and receive parcels on arrival
reception.info: Parcels in transit (loaded) appear here. Enter the received, missing or damaged pieces, then receive them. "Receive All" fully receives the selection. Only received parcels can be delivered.
reception.empty: No parcels in transit to receive.

manifest.title: Trip manifest
manifest.subtitle: Loading parcels and tracking baggage
manifest.info: Choose a trip: load compatible pending parcels, mark them arrived, and track the trip passengers baggage.

baggage.title: Baggage
baggage.subtitle: Baggage check-in and pickup
baggage.info: Baggage is attached to a trip at check-in. The passenger (ticket) is optional: without a ticket, enter the sender identity. Pickup is done by the passenger on arrival.

parcels.title: Parcels
parcels.subtitle: Register, track and pick up parcels
parcels.info: Register the parcel (sender, recipient, contents) and collect the amount at drop-off. The parcel starts as "Registered"; it will be assigned to a trip via the manifest, then picked up by the recipient on arrival.

fare.title: Fares
fare.subtitle: Pricing by route and by segment
fare.info: Set the fare for the full route (origin → destination), then add per-segment fares via the stops. These fares will feed the bookings.
fare.prompt_choose: Choose a route to view and set its fares.
fare.amount_hint: Enter here the price for the selected trip type.

co.title: Institutions
co.subtitle: Manage institutions (tenants)
co.admin_email_hint: If filled in, a head-office agency and this admin will be created automatically.
co.setup_intro: The initial setup was completed. Pass this information on to the administrator.
co.setup_pwd_warn: This password will no longer be shown. Copy it now.

hr.title: Employees
hr.subtitle: Institution staff
hr.info: Create, edit and view employees. The staff number is generated automatically if not provided. Contracts, leave and payroll will follow.

report.title: Reports
report.subtitle: Generate reports (PDF, Excel, CSV)
report.info: Select a report, fill in the filters, then generate the file in the desired format.

auth.signin_subtitle: Access your dashboard using your email and password.
auth.forgot_subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you instructions to reset your password.
auth.twostep_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
